patterns.what_worked: Audit-driven core fixes with red-first pins: UnitGUID/UnitIsUnit/UnitCreatureType routed through compat, ToT secret-boolean pass-through via SetAlphaFromBoolean, hunter aura-scan breaks removed, classic UnitAura pcall+precheck mirrored, ratings guarded, Hunter's Mark unknown branch made real, and the three additive helpers; 12/12 mutations killed; full gate 57/0, luacheck 2/0.
patterns.what_was_hard: Plain Lua cannot raise on a secret string/boolean, so the identity rails needed raising-__eq sentinels for table-shaped comparables plus comment-blind source pins for the string/boolean shapes; one existing compat pin (forever_secret_compat_state §2) encoded the pre-SEC-4 contract and needed a Lead-authorised re-cut.
